page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: one blank page of text area, with no printed text. Right page: only its left edge is visible, with two short fragmentary lines of text at the bottom, cut off by the scan edge.
page.notes: The left printed page is blank. The right printed page is cut off at the scan edge, so the two lines are fragments and their ends cannot be read. Their wording is only partly legible ("Herzog", "Restauri"), so this is an incomplete transcription. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible. The brown spot at lower left and the show-through stains are not printed text and are left out.
